text.quarkos_emotes.local_only: Emotes are only visible to you on this server
tooltip.quarkos_emotes.first_person: Cycle first-person behavior: show animated arms, switch to third person, or hide emotes. The camera returns when the emote ends.
tooltip.quarkos_emotes.cancel_on_move: Stop your emote when you move. Jumping, attacking, and taking damage always stop it.
tooltip.quarkos_emotes.play_sounds: Play the sounds included with emotes.
tooltip.quarkos_emotes.sound_volume: Cycle emote volume from 0% to 100% in 25% steps.
tooltip.quarkos_emotes.show_others: Show emotes shared by other players on compatible servers.
tooltip.quarkos_emotes.wheel_mode: Hold: release the wheel key over an emote to play it. Click: keep the wheel open until you select an emote.
tooltip.quarkos_emotes.reset_favorites: Clear your saved favorites. Add them again with F or right-click on the wheel.
tooltip.quarkos_emotes.favorites: Switch between all emotes and your eight saved favorites. F or right-click adds or removes the hovered emote.
tooltip.quarkos_emotes.previous_page: Previous page (Left arrow / Page Up / scroll).
tooltip.quarkos_emotes.next_page: Next page (Right arrow / Page Down / scroll).
